title: Level Design Tool
description: A Unity Editor extension for faster level assembly and object placement.
short: A Unity Editor extension for faster level assembly and placement of gameplay objects in a scene.
details: The tool was created to reduce repetitive manual work when assembling levels and placing objects in scenes.

The panel is built with UI Toolkit and runs directly inside the Unity Editor. It supports batch prefab placement, random rotation and scale, snap-to-grid and additional operations on selected objects.
Presets are provided for recurring layouts. A current object configuration can be saved and reused on other levels.
Preset data is stored using ScriptableObject, making it convenient to version and share through source control.
The tool also provides scene validation, including checks for missing components, duplicate objects and other potential issues before a build.
